issues.description: Method assembleBookstore: problem statement and template expect a parameterless function assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore, but the solution defines assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore while main() in the solution calls assembleBookstore() with no argument. Specifically: the problem statement asks for assembleBookstore() to create and return a Bookstore; the template contains a commented-out placeholder for private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore; the solution contains a call to assembleBookstore() with no parameters (solution Client.swift line 5) and a definition private static func assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore (solution Client.swift line 31). This parameter mismatch causes a compilation error and prevents students from running the provided solution as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's assembleBookstore signature match the template and problem statement by removing the unused parameter. Change the solution function declaration to: private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore. This keeps main() unchanged and resolves the compilation error.
